data.name: Echoes of the Dark Tomb
data.detailed_description:
Echoes of the Dark Tomb is a first-person horror exploration game set inside a mysterious ancient Egyptian tomb.

You enter the tomb in search of a legendary hidden treasure said to be buried deep within its ancient chambers. But the deeper you go, the more you realize something is terribly wrong. The tomb is not empty. It is protected by traps, ancient mechanisms, puzzles, and hostile entities guarding its secrets.

Your objective is to explore the tomb, solve environmental puzzles, survive deadly traps, and uncover the hidden treasure. Many areas are locked behind ancient mechanisms that require observation, logic, and exploration to unlock.

Every step deeper increases the danger. Spike traps can kill instantly. Enemies can detect and chase you. Darkness hides both secrets and threats.

The game focuses on tension, atmosphere, puzzle-solving, and survival. There is no hand-holding. Awareness, logic, and decision-making are the keys to progress and survival.

FEATURES:

• Immersive first-person exploration inside an ancient Egyptian tomb  

• Solve environmental puzzles to unlock new areas  

• Search for a legendary hidden treasure  

• Deadly traps including spike traps and environmental hazards  

• Hostile enemies that can detect and chase the player  

• Dark, tense, and atmospheric horror experience  

• Exploration-based gameplay focused on survival and puzzle-solving  

• Realistic lighting and sound design for maximum immersion  

The demo includes the first section of the tomb and introduces exploration, traps, enemies, and puzzle mechanics.

The full game will include deeper areas, new puzzles, new enemies, expanded exploration, and greater challenges.

Will you solve the tomb's secrets and claim the treasure… or become another lost soul inside the darkness?
